whatsappMessage:
Hi Team La Fumee,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.5★ ratings with over 1,600 reviews in Boring Road, Patna, but could benefit from an even smoother mobile ordering and table reservation experience for local diners.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, curated Mughlai & pizza menu, aur instant WhatsApp ordering integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://laaafumee.netlify.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team La Fumee, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (La Fumee on Boring Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct table reservations, your best-selling starters and pizzas, and lightning-fast mobile ordering. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact items aur pricing integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
